title: Tornado
summary: A tornado warning for your area means act quickly.
steps: Go to a basement, safe room, or small interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building, away from windows.
Cover your head and neck. Follow the shelter plan at work or school.
Mobile homes, tents, and vehicles are unsafe in a tornado. Reach a sturdy shelter if you can do so before it arrives.
Keep listening to local alerts and NOAA Weather Radio if available.
